content.short: Since 2019, Biconomy.com has run a centralized exchange covering spot, perpetual futures and Earn products on more than 140 tokens.
content.description: Biconomy.com is a crypto exchange and has no link to the Biconomy account-abstraction SDK, which is listed separately. Users trade spot pairs and perpetual futures, park assets in Earn products, and buy with fiat through third-party payment partners. It also runs a Kickstarter programme for new token launches. The company has offices in Canada and the EU, serves users across several regions, and keeps most customer assets in cold storage. Beyond spot and futures it now offers copy trading, P2P buying, dual investment products and a TradFi section, and it reports users in more than 150 countries.
